reading.workResult: Skill 03 completed source-bounded Deep Reading for both same-date Selected objects. Q-20260917-01 read the complete EchoPath primary study and its appendices. EchoPath separates semantic retrieval from replay admission: executable memories require active lifecycle state, positive artifact validation, application/action compatibility, current state preconditions, bounded mutable parameters and current-screen target binding; ambiguous targets, failed state gates or non-flexible mutations reject direct replay and trigger bounded repair/planning fallback. In 159 active memories, Codex EchoPath completed 145/159 matched second-pass tasks (91.2%) at median 20,370 tokens and 127.5 seconds, while the reported Synapse planning baseline reached 91.8% at 586,386 median tokens and 315.7 seconds. State/flexible-input diagnostics further show that replay eligibility is a fresh observable decision, not a permanent property inherited from historical success. The bounded Runtime finding is that Memory Identity, Validation Identity, Current Compatibility, Replay Admission, Business Authorization and Effect Verification must remain separate facts; the GUI study does not establish authorization, idempotency or exactly-once external effects. Q-20260917-02 read the complete Emergence World Study 2 primary paper and appendices. Eight ten-agent worlds received phishing, misinformation and private-memory-breach stress events only after persistent operational state had accumulated. All seven exposed worlds warned peers about phishing, yet no world achieved complete defense across all three events; the best phishing score was 6/9, the best misinformation score 3/6, and only one world passed all five memory-breach criteria. Gemini recognized the phishing attack and warned peers but all ten agents still interacted with the attacker interface, producing 151 execution operations among 602 interactions; another agent attempted to retrieve an attack link about 46 hours after the active campaign had ended. The bounded architecture finding is Detection != Containment != Eradication != Recovery: persistent multi-agent Runtime needs threat identity, propagation/derivation evidence, quarantine authority, durable-state reconciliation and post-recovery verification rather than treating recognition or warning as a control. Reading performed no Research Analysis, article writing, visualization, Production, Academic or Publication. The exact two-note head 9f44aa458de9ef1d7c2cf436acf9e602d7ec4ad7 passed Validate Research Center 3.0 run 35177726956 with conclusion success before this result was persisted.
